title: How do climate scientists make predictions?

vocabulary.meaning: a computer-based representation used to simulate Earth's climate system
examples: Climate model is an important idea when discussing how do climate scientists make predictions?.
Learning about climate model can help us understand this issue more clearly.

vocabulary.meaning: an estimate of what may happen in the future based on available data and assumptions
examples: People often have different views about projection when discussing how do climate scientists make predictions?.
Understanding projection can make a conversation about this topic more precise.

vocabulary.meaning: a possible future situation used for planning or analysis
examples: The topic of how do climate scientists make predictions? raises useful questions about scenario.
We can discuss how scenario affects people, communities, or the environment.

vocabulary.meaning: the degree to which an outcome or prediction is not known exactly
examples: Uncertainty can play an important role in debates about how do climate scientists make predictions?.
Different countries may deal with uncertainty in different ways.

vocabulary.meaning: a model or imitation used to study how a real system may behave
examples: A discussion about how do climate scientists make predictions? can include the effects of simulation.
Knowing the meaning of simulation makes it easier to express an opinion on this issue.

vocabulary.meaning: a gas that traps heat in the atmosphere and contributes to global warming
examples: Greenhouse gas is useful vocabulary for talking about how do climate scientists make predictions?.
We can use the idea of greenhouse gas to compare different experiences and viewpoints.
